members.name: Epic of Gilgamesh
members.note: Sumerian songs hardening into the standard Akkadian epic, the oldest literature we still read

members.name: Homeric epics
members.note: Iliad and Odyssey take fixed form out of an oral tradition

members.name: Greek tragedy
members.note: from Thespis at the first Dionysia contest to the deaths of Sophocles and Euripides

members.name: Golden Age of Latin literature
members.note: Cicero to Ovid's death: the Latin the West would imitate for a thousand years

members.name: Sanskrit epics
members.note: Mahabharata and Ramayana grow into their received form

members.name: Medieval romance
members.note: Arthur, Tristan and courtly love told in the vernacular rather than Latin

members.name: The Tale of Genji
members.note: Murasaki Shikibu's court novel, often called the world's first

members.name: Divine Comedy completed
members.note: Dante finishes it in exile, in the year he dies

members.name: Dante Alighieri
members.note: made Tuscan a language fit for the highest subject

members.name: Rise of the novel
members.note: prose fiction becomes the dominant form, Don Quixote to the English novelists

members.name: Don Quixote published
members.note: Part One appears in Madrid; the modern novel's usual starting gun

members.name: Miguel de Cervantes
members.note: soldier, captive and tax collector before the book that outlived them all

members.name: Paradise Lost
members.note: Milton, blind and politically defeated, writes English's last great epic

members.name: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
members.note: Werther, Faust and a whole national literature in one lifetime

members.name: Romanticism in literature
members.note: Lyrical Ballads opens it: feeling, nature and the self against neoclassical rule

members.name: Frankenstein published
members.note: Mary Shelley's monster, dreamed up at Geneva two years earlier

members.name: Jane Austen
members.note: six novels that made the domestic interior serious

members.name: Literary realism
members.note: the novel turns to ordinary society; the painters' Realism is a separate block

members.name: Charles Dickens
members.note: wrote the industrial city into fiction, in monthly instalments

members.name: Madame Bovary trial
members.note: Flaubert acquitted of offending public morals; realism's founding scandal

members.name: Literary naturalism
members.note: Zola pushes realism into clinical determinism

members.name: Fyodor Dostoevsky
members.note: the mock execution and Siberia behind every later novel

members.name: Leo Tolstoy
members.note: War and Peace, then a renunciation of everything that made it possible

members.name: Nobel Prize in Literature founded
members.note: first awarded to Sully Prudhomme, famously not to Tolstoy

members.name: Literary modernism
members.note: stream of consciousness, fragmentation and myth break the realist frame

members.name: Ulysses published
members.note: Sylvia Beach prints it in Paris on Joyce's fortieth birthday

members.name: James Joyce
members.note: left Dublin at twenty-two and wrote about nothing else

members.name: Virginia Woolf
members.note: the novel of inner time, and the case for a room of one's own

members.name: Beat Generation
members.note: the road, the confession and an obscenity trial that opened American publishing

members.name: Magical realism
members.note: Carpentier names 'lo real maravilloso' and the Latin American Boom follows

members.name: One Hundred Years of Solitude
members.note: Garcia Marquez's Macondo turns the Boom into a world event

members.name: Postmodern literature
members.note: metafiction, irony and ground that keeps giving way

members.name: Jorge Luis Borges
members.note: libraries, mirrors and forking paths, all in short stories

members.name: Toni Morrison
members.note: wrote American slavery from the inside and won the Nobel for it

members.name: Silent film era
members.note: from the Lumieres' first paying audience to sound's clean sweep

members.name: First public film screening
members.note: the Lumieres charge admission in a Grand Cafe basement; cinema's birthday

members.name: Georges Melies
members.note: the conjuror who discovered that film could lie

members.name: Indian cinema
members.note: Raja Harishchandra onward; by output the largest film industry on earth

members.name: The Birth of a Nation
members.note: Griffith's leap in film grammar wrapped around Klan propaganda

members.name: German Expressionist cinema
members.note: Caligari's crooked shadows until the Nazis empty the studios; many textbooks end it earlier, at Metropolis

members.name: Soviet montage
members.note: editing as argument, until socialist realism calls it formalist

members.name: Sergei Eisenstein
members.note: built a theory of editing, then spent his last years out of favour

members.name: The Jazz Singer
members.note: synchronised speech arrives and the silent era is over within two years

members.name: Hollywood studio system
members.note: eight studios own production, distribution and the theatres, until the 1948 Paramount decree

members.name: Hollywood Production Code
members.note: written in 1930 but enforced from 1934, until the ratings system replaces it

members.name: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
members.note: the first feature-length cel-animated film, and it paid for a studio

members.name: Citizen Kane
members.note: Welles at twenty-five; the standing benchmark for 'greatest film'

members.name: Orson Welles
members.note: peaked first and spent forty years financing the rest himself

members.name: Italian neorealism
members.note: Rome Open City to Umberto D.: real streets, non-actors, war rubble

members.name: Cannes Film Festival begins
members.note: planned for 1939 and cancelled by the war; the art film's marketplace

members.name: Japanese Golden Age cinema
members.note: Rashomon wins Venice and the West discovers Ozu, Mizoguchi and Kurosawa

members.name: Akira Kurosawa
members.note: the Japanese director Hollywood kept remaking

members.name: Alfred Hitchcock
members.note: made suspense a craft with rules, and himself a brand

members.name: Charlie Chaplin
members.note: the Tramp made him the first global star, and politics later cost him America

members.name: French New Wave
members.note: Cahiers critics turn director and the auteur idea goes worldwide

members.name: Breathless premieres
members.note: Godard's jump cuts announce that the rules were only conventions

members.name: Agnes Varda
members.note: the New Wave's first film, and sixty more years of the essay film

members.name: New Hollywood
members.note: Bonnie and Clyde to Heaven's Gate: directors briefly run the studios

members.name: Blockbuster era
members.note: Jaws invents the wide-release summer film and the franchise eats the rest

members.name: Toy Story
members.note: the first fully computer-animated feature

members.name: Streaming era
members.note: Netflix starts streaming and the cinema stops being the default screen

members.name: Parasite wins Best Picture
members.note: the first film not in English to take Best Picture
